rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when food or another object goes down the wrong way and makes someone choke.

example.traditional: 我食飯嗰陣成日唔小心哽親。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 faan6 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 m4 siu2 sam1 gang2 can1

rows.traditional: 搞到 A 透唔到氣
rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou2 A tau3 m4 dou2 hei3
rows.note: Use this when an obstruction, fumes, strangling, or tight clothing causes someone to be unable to breathe.

example.english: The smoke makes me choke, and I can't breathe.
example.jyutping: di1 jin1 gaau2 dou2 ngo5 tau3 m4 dou2 hei3

rows.note: Use this for filling or clogging a passage, pipe, opening, or other route.

example.english: The hair clogged the drain and nearly made me choke.
example.traditional: 啲頭髮塞住咗去水位，搞到我差啲窒息。
example.jyutping: di1 tau4 faat3 sak1 zyu6 zo2 heoi3 seoi2 wai2 gaau2 dou2 ngo5 caa1 di1 zat6 sik1

rows.note: Use this when words or a voice become stuck in the throat, especially because of emotion.

example.english: Whenever I talk about Mum, I choke and can't get the words out.
example.traditional: 我一講到阿媽，就哽住講唔出聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gong2 dou3 aa3 maa1 zau6 gang2 zyu6 gong2 m4 ceot1 seng1
